# Browser dependencies

These files are embedded locally; the workspace does not load code from a CDN.

- Marked 17.0.5, `marked.umd.js`, MIT: https://github.com/markedjs/marked
- DOMPurify 3.4.17, `purify.min.js`, Apache-2.0 OR MPL-2.0: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify

Source licenses are included alongside the files. Markdown is sanitized before insertion; raw HTML and remote images are disabled in conversation output.
